episodes.synopsis: In a seemingly utopian future, the Black Hole gang and its leader investigate a series of disappearances. Meanwhile, a mysterious young girl confronts a kidnapper in a back alley, and things don’t go according to plan.
episodes.title: Somewhere Outside of Eden

episodes.synopsis: The Eden System may be facing competition. Si Ge asks Headmaster Lu to find out more, and entrusts Zhan Lu with a secret mission.
episodes.title: General Lin's Alias Si Ge

episodes.synopsis: Zhan Lu begins to experience errors. Lu Bixing’s school runs into trouble, but he receives encouragement from unexpected quarters. Meanwhile, there’s more to the League Secretary’s wife than meets the eye.
episodes.title: The Starry Sky Above Us

episodes.synopsis: Neither the Starsea students nor their headmaster can resist trying out new technology. Meanwhile, Si Ge attends a gangster meet-up and finds out what Venom Nest has really been up to.
episodes.title: Making God or Going to Hell

episodes.synopsis: The Starsea students are trapped in the Venom Nest base. Headmaster Lu tries to rescue them - but he’s still in disguise. Si Ge is confronted with the ghosts of his past.
episodes.title: Si Ge and His Duplicate

episodes.synopsis: Headmaster Lu protects his wayward students while Si Ge and One-Eyed Hawk deal with Venom Nest. Some unexpected relationships are revealed.
episodes.title: In His Genes

episodes.synopsis: A new enemy appears on the scene, putting Si Ge and company - and their entire planet - in grave danger.
episodes.title: Farewell, North Tower Planet

episodes.synopsis: Si Ge, Lu Bixing, and their companions regroup at an old supply station as they come to terms with the loss of their home and prepare their next move.
episodes.title: Being Homeless and Brainless

episodes.synopsis: The group has to face down yet another attack. As their supplies dwindle, they reflect on the state of the League, and Si Ge wonders who’s really backing Prince Kelet.
episodes.title: A Narrow Escape

episodes.synopsis: Si Ge presses 001 for information about the war on the League. The group fends off another mecha attack and learn more about who their enemies might be.
episodes.title: Si Ge and One-Eyed Hawk

episodes.synopsis: One-Eyed Hawk tells his son about Si Ge’s past. Faced with the threat of another, more powerful shockwave, the group seeks help from some unlikely allies.
episodes.title: Desert

episodes.synopsis: While Si Ge pursues a dangerous course among the asteroids, Lu Bixing and his students work on mecha control.
episodes.title: Empty-Brain Syndrome

episodes.synopsis: As Lu and his students struggle to control the group’s mechas, Si Ge hatches a plan to draw their enemies away, using himself as a decoy.
episodes.title: Inhuman

episodes.synopsis: While Si Ge explores Inhuman’s ship and uncovers a dark secret, Lu and his students prepare for their moment of reckoning.
episodes.title: Ten-Second Countdown

episodes.synopsis: Inhuman tracks Si Ge to the hidden warp point. While they prepare for a showdown, Lu decides to take matters into his own hands and search for his friend.
episodes.title: Surprise

episodes.synopsis: Lu Bixing continues his desperate search for Si Ge, while Si Ge deals with Inhuman once and for all. In another galaxy, Lin Jingshu reveals her plans for Eden.
episodes.title: Yesterday Once More
